@pytest.fixture
def stub_gh(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    bindir = tmp_path / "bin"
    bindir.mkdir()
    script = bindir / "gh"
    script.write_text(STUB.format(python=sys.executable))
    script.chmod(script.stat().st_mode | stat.S_IEXEC)
    monkeypatch.setenv("PATH", f"{bindir}{os.pathsep}{os.environ['PATH']}")
